import ctypes
import os

def gsl_sf_ellint_RF_e(x, y, z, mode):
    # Validate inputs
    if x <= 0 or y <= 0 or z <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Inputs x, y, and z must be positive.")

    # Load the libraries
    libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
    libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

    if not os.path.exists(libgslcblas_path) or not os.path.exists(libgsl_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError("GSL libraries not found at specified paths.")

    ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

    # Define the gsl_sf_result structure
    class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("val", ctypes.c_double), ("err", ctypes.c_double)]

    # Define the function prototype
    gsl.gsl_sf_ellint_RF_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(GslSfResult)]
    gsl.gsl_sf_ellint_RF_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

    # Prepare the result structure
    result = GslSfResult()

    # Call the function
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_ellint_RF_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.c_double(y), ctypes.c_double(z), ctypes.c_int(mode), ctypes.byref(result))

    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"GSL function call failed with status code {status}.")

    return result.val, result.err
